entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the exact low-resolution logo to restore. Input image 2 is the same logo displayed on white, supplied only to make original lettering and transparent cutouts readable. Restore the SAME logo to a crisp high-resolution raster PNG; do not redesign or reinterpret it.
EATON: exact original blue geometric custom block capitals EATON with their distinctive negative-space cuts and round negative-space dot in the O; below is the exact gray italic tagline 'Powering Business Worldwide'. Preserve original wordmark/tagline positioning and relative sizes, including existing side margins.
Output canvas: 1536 by 512 pixels, landscape 3:1. Uniformly scale the entire original 185 by 45 canvas to 1536 pixels wide (keeping every original margin), center it vertically, and add only transparent padding above and below to fit the 3:1 canvas. Do not stretch or crop the artwork. Preserve exact original colors, shape topology, lineweights, text, branding, proportions and composition. Improve edge clarity and remove pixelation only. True alpha transparency outside the artwork and through all original transparent letter cutouts; no white rectangle, no shadow, no outline additions, no checkerboard background, no extra marks or text.
entries.inspectionNotes: Visually compared original and selected restoration on a white background. Brand words, recognizable symbol geometry and colors are preserved; restored contours, stroke weights and minor spacing remain generative approximations rather than pixel-identical originals.
